newsitem.title: LATVIA: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate leaps at auction.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate leaps at auction.

text.p: The average yield at an auction of 91-day Lithuanian Treasury bills jumped on Tuesday to 9.31 percent from 8.22 percent, the central bank said.
All amounts are in millions of litas.A
MATURITY AV YIELD LAST TIME MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD

Settlement date for today's auction was Febuary 14 and the bills mature on May 16. The next auctions are on Febuary 17 when 40 million litas of 92-day paper will auctioned and on February 18 when 40 million litas of 182-day T-bills will on offer.
